name: dnsmasq Self-Hosted DNS/DHCP
free_limit: GPLv2-or-v3 self-hosted DNS caching/forwarding, DHCP/DHCPv6 and router advertisement for small networks; no vendor-side DNS query or device allowance.
watch_out: Runs on your own network/server; DNS forwarding depends on upstream resolvers and their policies. DNSSEC and network configuration require operator maintenance. GPL distribution obligations apply; hosting and networking costs are separate.
